menu.title.label: Label
prefs.language.hint: interface language; the app reloads to apply it
prefs.photos.lead: What a photo starts with the first time it is opened, if it has no edit yet in Immage or darktable. Photos already edited keep their own settings. Keywords follow the photo's first edit instead.
prefs.row.profile.summary: Starting look for new RAW photos.
prefs.row.profile.hint: the color look a raw starts with: one of AgX's own, or darktable's color balance rgb's; JPEGs keep the camera's
prefs.row.expcomp.summary: Base exposure for new RAW photos.
prefs.row.expcomp.hint: added to a raw's exposure on a module of its own: Exposure still starts at 0 and adds to it, and Auto allows for it; JPEGs get none
prefs.row.autotone.summary: Apply Auto to new RAW photos.
prefs.row.autotone.hint: Basic's Auto once a raw has rendered: Exposure, AgX's range, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites and Blacks
prefs.row.preset.hint: applied to new raw photos; Default gives them lens corrections
prefs.row.presetjpeg.summary: Apply the preset to new non-raw photos too.
prefs.row.presetjpeg.hint: JPEGs, TIFFs and other non-raw photos get the preset without Lens Corrections, which the camera did already, or settings that need a raw
prefs.row.newpreset.summary: Save selected settings from this photo.
prefs.row.newpreset.hint: from the open photo, with only the settings you tick
prefs.row.newpreset.title: open a photo first
prefs.row.keywords.summary: Tag photos when edited; remove tags on reset.
prefs.row.keywords.hint: added to a photo once you edit it, and taken off if it is reset to unedited; Immich reads them from the sidecar, so its Tags filter finds the photos edited here
prefs.row.copyright.hint: filled in once you edit a photo, if it has none yet from the camera or typed in; {year} is the year it was taken
prefs.row.creator: Creator
prefs.row.creator.hint: the same, for the photo's creator
prefs.row.canvas.summary: Background behind the photo. L cycles colors.
prefs.row.canvas.hint: behind the photo, full screen too; neutral gray judges tones without a dark surround, white as on a print. L steps through them
prefs.row.overlaycolor.hint: a mask's overlay on the photo, and the heal brush's stroke as it is painted
prefs.row.opacity.hint: how solid a mask's overlay is where it is fully selected: {opacity}%
prefs.row.guidecolor.hint: the crop frame and grid, the straighten line, Transform's and the vignette's guides, and a mask shape's outline
prefs.row.focus.summary: One panel at a time; ⌥-click for more.
prefs.row.focus.hint: opening a panel closes the others; ⌥-click opens one alongside
prefs.row.autohide.summary: Reveal panels at the window edges.
prefs.row.autohide.hint: the side panels and filmstrip slide away when the pointer leaves them, and back at their edge (the rail, or below the toolbar); a pin keeps one open
prefs.row.scroll.summary: Adjust sliders with the mouse wheel.
prefs.row.scroll.hint: off, scrolling over the panels only scrolls them, so an edit cannot change by accident
prefs.row.scrollstep.summary: {percent}% of the range per wheel click
prefs.row.scrollstep.hint: how far one click of the wheel moves a slider: {percent}% of its range
prefs.row.opengen.hint: switch to editing after HDR or panorama merge, AI denoise, positive export, or the first result from a plugin
prefs.row.posformat.hint: Export to Library in the Negative and Film Simulation panels saves a separate positive with the conversion and edits baked in; both formats use lossless compression
prefs.row.negwarn.summary: Explain which Basic tools conversion disables.
prefs.row.negwarn.hint: opening the Negative panel says which of Basic's tools a converted negative turns off
prefs.row.stack: Stack RAW+JPEG pairs as one photo
prefs.row.stack.summary: Group matching files for browsing and actions.
prefs.row.stack.hint: a raw and the JPEG, HEIF or OM System .ORI of the same name show as one, and a rating, reject or delete takes them all
prefs.row.tour.hint: a short tour of Immage when it opens
prefs.row.backup.summary: Save or restore settings, presets, looks and keywords.
prefs.row.backup.hint: one .zip holding the parts you choose: preferences and library, edit and export presets, looks, Edit In plugins and keywords; restoring replaces the chosen parts and keeps a copy of what it replaced
prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.note: changes apply as you make them
prefs.openPhoto: Open a photo to run it.
prefs.openPhoto.hint: open a photo to run it
prefs.row.gpu.hint.some: what AI upscaling at export runs on
prefs.row.gpu.hint.none: none found on this computer, so AI upscaling is not offered
prefs.row.renderer.hint: draws Immage's interface; photo processing uses Edit on the GPU separately. Automatic uses the system default renderer. running: {name}
prefs.row.renderer.hint.external: remove __EGL_VENDOR_LIBRARY_FILENAMES from the launch environment to change this
prefs.row.renderer.hint.relaunch: relaunch to apply the selected renderer
prefs.row.gpuedit.summary: Use the graphics card for edits.
prefs.row.gpuedit.hint: renders the photo on the graphics card while you edit, as exports and the whole-photo render behind the viewer already are; off keeps edits on the CPU. without a usable GPU darktable uses the CPU either way. smaller drafts for slow sliders still apply, though on the GPU frames are seldom slow enough
prefs.profile.performance.summary: 50% previews; smaller drafts for slow edits.
prefs.profile.quality.hint: for high-end computers: drag previews at full size, without grain, texture and diffuse or sharpen's sharpening, which return in full on release
prefs.profile.balanced.hint: for decent modern computers: drag previews at 75%, without grain, texture and diffuse or sharpen's sharpening, and in full on release
prefs.profile.performance.hint: for older computers: drag previews at 50%, smaller again for slow sliders, with the detail loupe on and the whole-photo render behind the viewer only the viewer's size
prefs.row.dragsize.summary: Preview resolution during edits; full on release.
prefs.row.dragsize.hint: while a slider, wheel or curve moves, the photo renders at this share of its full size, and in full on release. 100% turns off smaller drafts for slow sliders
prefs.row.drafts.summary: Reduce preview size when edits are slow.
prefs.row.drafts.hint: while a slider early in darktable's pipe moves (Exposure, White Balance, noise reduction), the photo renders smaller again, so each frame comes sooner. off keeps the preview size
prefs.row.drafttime.hint: how long darktable may take on a frame while a slider moves before the next one is smaller; less is quicker and softer. applies when smaller drafts are on
prefs.row.loupe.summary: Show a 100% detail preview in Adjustments.
prefs.row.loupe.hint: show a 100% preview in Adjustments; use its picker to inspect a point on the photo
prefs.row.shared.hint: hands each frame to the window in memory both share, rather than copying it through Tauri. off to compare the two in the GUI benchmark
prefs.row.screenscale: Drag drafts at the screen's scale
prefs.row.screenscale.summary: Match drag previews to the display scale.
prefs.row.screenscale.hint: while a slider moves, renders the photo for this screen's {screen}%, not the {window}% the window is drawn at and shrunk from: fewer pixels for darktable. the frame after letting go is full size either way. off to compare the two in the GUI benchmark
prefs.row.fitscale: Fit frames at the screen's scale
prefs.row.fitscale.summary: Match Fit previews to the display scale; off for sharper detail.
prefs.row.fitscale.hint: renders the settled Fit frame for this screen's scale and lets the page enlarge it. turn it off if the photo looks soft. takes effect on the next frame
prefs.row.readahead.summary: Decode nearby RAW photos in advance.
prefs.row.readahead.hint: photos whose raws are decoded while you edit, in the direction you last stepped, so the arrow keys open them without the decode (some 300 ms for a compressed raw). each holds its raw in memory, about 50 MB for 24 megapixels
prefs.row.readaheadboth.summary: Also decode photos behind the current one.
prefs.row.readaheadboth.hint: as many photos behind the open one too, for stepping back
prefs.row.memory.hint: how much memory Immage's caches use in total: the render caches, the views of the photo already shown and the library's thumbnails. {level}. the render part applies once Immage starts again; views and thumbnails follow at once
prefs.row.memory.hint.small: Small keeps to about an eighth of this computer's memory, for working beside other large programs; more of each edit is worked out again
prefs.row.memory.hint.default: Default uses about half of this computer's memory
prefs.row.memory.hint.large: Large uses about two thirds, for when Immage is the only large program running
prefs.row.perfhud.summary: Show frame rate and rendering times.
prefs.row.perfhud.hint: over the photo: frame rate, the time from a slider moving to the photo changing, where that time went, and darktable's slowest modules
prefs.row.bench.summary: Measure editing speed on a photo copy.
prefs.row.bench.hint: drags the main sliders on the open photo and back, zooms in and out, and saves timing, frame pacing and resource usage; every slider ends where it started. use a copy of a photo you care about
prefs.row.gpucheck.summary: Compare CPU and GPU renders on a photo copy.
prefs.row.gpucheck.hint: renders the open photo on the CPU and on the GPU, then with each of several modules turned on, and compares them; records OpenCL errors, fallbacks to the CPU and a canceled GPU render. every control ends where it started. use a copy of a photo you care about, and send the saved report back
prefs.row.tuner.summary: Find preview settings for your speed targets.
prefs.row.tuner.hint: load a representative RAW from your usual work and use your normal window size. finds the highest-quality preview meeting your FPS and latency targets; Apply verifies the result
prefs.row.autoupdate.hint: once a day, from Immage's releases on GitHub
prefs.row.gpl.hint: GNU General Public License, version 3 or later
prefs.row.libs.hint: the engine's libraries, each under its own license, and where their source is
prefs.about.libs.title: Bundled Libraries
prefs.row.components.hint: the Rust crates and npm packages built into the app, and their licenses
prefs.about.components.title: App Components
cache.thumbs.hint: so a folder seen before opens at once; a thumbnail is made again after an edit. past the limit, those not looked at longest go first. none is kept with under 5 GB free
cache.immichThumbs.hint: search results scrolled through. past the limit, those not looked at longest go first. none is kept with under 5 GB free
cache.immichOriginals.hint: photos opened from Immich; one you have edited is kept whatever the limit, as its edit is beside it
cache.title: Cache
modules.lead: Choose which darktable module each tool uses; it determines the sliders shown. Existing edits keep their modules, and new choices apply when Preferences closes. Global and Masks have separate choices.
modules.title: Modules
modules.row.hint.default: the module darktable's AgX workflow uses for each tool, and contrast & texture for Clarity and Texture
modules.row.hint.custom: each tool's module as set below
immich.needkey.server: enter the API key for this server to save
immich.needkey.certs: enter the API key again to change the certificate setting
immich.test.idle: check the server and the key
immich.test.browse: searching from the Library panel needs {list}
immich.lead: Immage checks new photos against your Immich library while importing, can export to its albums, and searches it from the Library panel.
immich.row.use.hint: look photos up on the server during an import
immich.row.url.hint: plain http sends the key unencrypted
immich.row.certs.hint: accept a server certificate no authority signed
immich.row.matchpath.hint: a photo only counts as in Immich at the path the import gives it
immich.row.prefix.hint: where the library sits inside Immich
immich.use.title: taken from a photo on the server
immich.row.path.hint: where an external library's folder sits on the server
immich.row.local.summary: Local results open directly; other results download first.
immich.row.local.hint: the same folder here: a search result found in it opens directly, anything else is downloaded first
plugins.lead: Send photos to external editors with right-click › Edit In. Returned files appear beside their photo, ready to edit.
plugins.row.name: Name
plugins.row.name.hint: as the Edit In menu shows it
plugins.notfound: {name} was not found on this computer
plugins.send.raw.summary: RAWs return without edits; TIFFs bake edits and may clip saturated colors.
plugins.send.orig.summary: TIFFs include edits; originals suit raw-aware apps.
plugins.send.raw.hint: raws keep the most color and come back as a raw DNG, without the edit; TIFFs carry the edit so far, but very saturated colors can clip
plugins.send.orig.hint: TIFFs carry the edit so far; originals suit applications that read raws
plugins.row.look.summary: Macro Studio finish; Enhanced adds sharpness and clarity.
plugins.row.look.hint: Macro Studio's finish on the stack; Enhanced sharpens and adds clarity
plugins.row.results.summary: Override the usual location for returned files.
plugins.onreturn.hint: on a returned file, the first time it opens: {hint}
plugins.pureraw: Save DNGs; Immage opens each when ready.
plugins.bracket: Choose a focus bracket; saved stacks return as DNG.
mapkey.read: Could not read the saved search key: {error}
mapkey.save: Could not save the search key: {error}
mapkey.remove: Could not remove the saved search key: {error}
mapkey.hint: Search by place name in the map's location picker. Search results move the map; they do not set photo coordinates. Map tiles and manual pin placement work without a key.
mapkey.stored: Stored in your system keyring; never shown after saving.
modules.advanced.lead: In Advanced mode, hidden modules leave Add module, the module search and the tone mapper switch. A photo that uses a hidden module still shows its card, marked hidden, so every edit stays reachable.
modules.lut.summary: Where the LUT 3D module finds its files.
modules.lut.hint: the LUT 3D card's file button opens here and refuses files outside it; a photo keeps the file's path relative to this folder. Empty uses your home folder, as darktable does
modules.essentials.title: Hide every module without a Simple equivalent
prefs.row.editmode.hint: Simple shows Immage's sliders. Advanced shows the same groups with darktable's own modules. The photo and its edits do not change
prefs.row.workers.summary: Thumbnail, ORF metadata and photo transfer workers. 2 by default.
prefs.row.workers.hint: how many library thumbnails, ORF metadata tasks and photo transfers run at the same time. These limits are separate, so this is not a shared total. Transfers keep each photo and its sidecars together. More workers can help on fast disks or network drives; fewer may be quicker when the drive is busy. Changes apply to subsequent import batches and new move or copy jobs
